column1: # Vehicle generations, keyed by the make and model corgi-rs decodes.
# vPIC does not record generations: NHTSA registers what a vehicle *is*, not
# how the manufacturer markets its redesign cycle. This table supplies them.
# Columns: make, model, year_from, year_to, ordinal, code, name
#   year_to  0 means the generation is still current
#   ordinal  0 means the generation has no commonly used number
#   code     the manufacturer's platform or chassis code, blank when there is none
# Model years, inclusive, as the VIN encodes them -- not calendar years.
# Boundaries are checked against the VIN body codes of ~627,000 auction lots by
# BMW names its models after the engine variant, so a generation entry is
# needed per variant. The generation itself is the chassis code of the series.
